t: The Oosten | AZA USA / AZA US
s: December 11, 2020 - The Oosten, on South Williamsburg’s district, is a perfect mix between old and new Brooklyn. Dutch designer Piet Boon used clean, streamlined elements – concrete and steel – for the Oosten’s seven different units to create stunning variations of the facades.
